title: xanthoxalis refracta
intro: Xanthoxalis refracta, commonly known as yellow-sorrel or sheep's sorrel, is a perennial herb belonging to the oxalis family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Xanthoxalis refracta involve its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ascorbic acid, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
